**Needs changes before merge.**

Review tier: SAFETY. This PR adds a post, so it changes posted G-code. Built and tested locally, on a trial merge of head `f3721d6a8` with `upstream/main` `893e749c0`. The merge has no text conflicts.

## What looks good

- `g-edm.cps` has a provenance header. It names its public sources and says that no G-RBLv3 source was read. It uses no HSMWorks or Autodesk material.
- The post fails closed. A taper that is not a number (`NaN`) is refused as a taper. An arc with no centre is refused. Each refusal names the operation.
- The arc `I J` words use the same `IJKIncrement - Start` form as `wire-iso.cps` and `sodick-wire.cps` (`IJKIncrement` holds the absolute centre, `crates/post/src/post/cnc.rs:184-187`).
- "Generic ISO Wire EDM" stays `WIRE_POSTS[0]`. The test `g_edm_post_serves_wire_edms_only_and_is_never_the_default` pins this.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2700-g-edm-post.md` gives the reason for each word that is not written, and for each dropped item.
- No existing golden changed. No snapshot PNG changed. No `CHANGELOG.md` edit. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2700`.

## New golden, read line by line

`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/g-edm/wire_slug_punch.nc`:

- The header is comments only. Then `G21 G90 G17`.
- `G0 X-30. Y0.` goes to the stated start point `[-30, 0]`.
- The punch path is offset by 0.165 mm from the 40 x 20 slug. This is the wire radius 0.125 plus the R1 gap 0.04. The path is outside the slug on all four sides, so it does not cut into the slug. The outer corners are sharp line intersections, so they cut only material outside the slug.
- The lead-in and lead-out are on `Y0.`, from `X-30.` to `X-20.165`.
- `M30` is the last line. There is no `F`, `%`, `O`, `G4x`, `G54`, `Z`, `U` or `V` word.

## Results (local, trial merge with main)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Build `camcraft-app` tests | **FAILED**: `g_edm_post` does not compile (item 1) |
| `camcraft-app --test g_edm_post` (with the one-line local fix below) | 8 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test conformance` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test wire_post` | 12 passed |
| `camcraft-app`: `posting`, `post_not_judged`, `post_script_options`, `post_serves_kind`, `post_serves_plasma`, `post_spindle_rule_all`, `post_unit_word`, `sodick_wire_post`, `sodick_wire_passes`, `wire_sharp_corners`, `wire_iso_decimal`, `wire_taper`, `wire_4axis`, `machine_library` | all passed (96 tests) |
| `camcraft-post`: lib, `script_g_edm`, `comment_escape` | 85, 11, 4 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | stopped by the local time limit after 123 steps (all post steps, the app build): 0 failed. The other app steps did not run. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Heavy lanes (`app heavy: every target`, because `crates/app/src/posting.rs` changed) | not run |

The local fix was only to make the test compile for this review. It was not pushed.

Extra suites run: none were needed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code. The new fixture `crates/app/tests/edm/g-edm-fixture.mch` is read only by `g_edm_post`, and that suite ran.

## Mutations (each guard turned off, the pins run, then restored)

- Skim guard off (`EdmCondition` while threaded): `g_edm_refuses_skims_by_name` red.
- G54-only guard off: `g_edm_refuses_what_the_controller_cannot_be_told` red.
- Rapid-while-threaded guard off (`onRapid`, `if (threaded)`): **all 8 app pins and all 11 script pins stay green** (item 2).

## Requested before merge

1. **The new test does not compile after a merge with main.** Main added the field `sharp_corners` to `WireContourOp` (commit `543e9f1f8`, #3207). The compiler gives this error:
   ```
   error[E0063]: missing field `sharp_corners` in initializer of `WireContourOp`
     --> crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs:67:14
   ```
   Fix: merge `origin/main` into the branch. Add `sharp_corners: false,` after `skims,` in `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs:79`. The other wire tests on main use the same line. With that line, all 8 pins pass on the trial merge.

2. **The rapid-while-threaded refusal has no pin.** `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` `onRapid` writes no word. Its only guard is the refusal when `threaded` is true. If that guard is lost, a rapid after the first cut is dropped silently. The next `G1` then cuts a straight line from the last cut point. The verified path does not have that line. This is a silent wrong cut. Fix: add a pin in `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs`. Insert a `MoveKind::Rapid` record between two cut moves of `records()`, and assert with `refused(...)`: a warning that holds "Punch1" and "rapid with the wire threaded", and no cut word after it.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The heavy plan reaches `app heavy: every target` (the change to `crates/app/src/posting.rs`). This is a `P6` `feat`. The heavy result is owed to the wave run before the merge at the cut (AGENTS.md "Owed heavy result").
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` and `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` merged cleanly with main at this time. The body lists the open PRs that touch the same tables.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
